metadata.title: Humpback Titans of the Deep: Majestic Breaches in a Living Ocean Cathedral
metadata.description: A humpback whale breaks the surface like a comet—silvery flukes flashing, spray erupting, and the ocean answering in thunderous rhythm. metadata.description: A silvery spine of sound rises from the calm deep blue—then, with breathtaking grace, a humpback whale breaches, turning the ocean into a cathedral of spray and song.
